info.name: Resource availability for a rolling timeframe

items.docs:
Splits a given time window into a sequence of slots at a specified interval of size "gridSize"; then aggregates resource availability into it, against the given job. Availability is determined by working hours, holidays, existing jobs and activities. Resource must be available for the entire duration of the slot to be returned in the list.
